$comment: CRM sync (docs/crm.md). Read by the worker (worker/crm.py) and by `pnpm crm:sync`, which creates the custom fields, the extra deal stages and the PostHog destinations below. stages: billing event type (worker/billing.py) -> deal stage value; an event type not listed leaves the deal alone. stageOptions: stages crm:sync adds to the CRM's stage field if missing (Twenty ships NEW, SCREENING, MEETING, PROPOSAL, CUSTOMER). signals: a PostHog event that, for a user whose organization has at least minMembers members and is on one of `plans` (empty = any), tags the company with `name` (a value of the company's productSignals field).
